cover_letter.greeting: Dear BlackRock Portfolio Analytics Group Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Analytics Specialist, Associate role in the Portfolio Analytics Group. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. PAG appeals to me because it sits where portfolio data turns into answers people actually use, and that is the kind of work I have enjoyed most.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%. I also worked on AI-powered analytical dashboards, where I owned the mapping and QA, and they saved the team 4+ hours a week on reporting. At JPMorgan I ran performance analysis and peer benchmarking on marketing-channel budget allocations and found 30% efficiency gains that guided where the money went next.

That maps well to digging into data, checking that the numbers hold up, and explaining what they mean to the people relying on them. My MBA coursework in valuation and corporate finance has given me a stronger base in financial products to go with the analytics. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team.
